responsibility: Declares the Rust frontend bridge between lexer tokens and procedural-macro token streams. The header exposes conversions from vectors of const_TokenPtr into ProcMacro::TokenStream, the reverse conversion back to frontend tokens, and a helper for converting a single literal token, defining the public interface used where parser/expander code crosses into libproc_macro_internal representations.
same_name_distinction: Header half of the rust-token-converter pair: it declares the conversion API between frontend tokens and proc-macro token streams, including convert_literal, while rust-token-converter.cc implements the detailed token, group, punctuation, literal, and span conversions.
